Plunge fiberglass pools Big enjoyment, small footprint.

Official Barrier Reef specs, with a free 3D design and site visit from iTop Pools.

Get my free 3D design →or call (904) 685-2555

A plunge pool is a small fiberglass pool for cooling off, sitting and water exercise, and it fits tight lots and courtyards. iTop Pools in Jacksonville offers these Barrier Reef plunge models, from the 16'6" Crispin to the Coral Cay, which runs up to 30 feet but stays narrow.
